sloka: ततस्तु देवसैन्येन राक्षसानां बृहद्बलम् ।दशांशं स्थापितं युद्धे शेषं नीतं यमक्षयम् ।। ७.२९.२ ॥
transliteration: tatastu devasainyena rākṣasānāṁ bṛhadbalam ।daśāṁśaṁ sthāpitaṁ yuddhe śeṣaṁ nītaṁ yamakṣayam ।। 7.29.2 ॥

translations.english: Then, by the army of gods, only one-tenth of the great Rākṣasa army remained in the battle, while the rest were sent to the abode of Yama.
